news.words: Watson underwent an MRI on his injured left ankle Monday... Watson left M&T Bank Stadium in a walking boot. "I'll be fine," Watson said Sunday... "I'll be ready to go 1 o'clock on Sunday."
Stefanski didn't have any other updates on Watson's ankle Monday. Watson missed all but one quarter of four games with a rotator cuff strain in his throwing shoulder earlier this season.
